Auteuil (16e arr.) — Paris, France

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

One of Paris's wealthiest, most residential quartiers, with no notable street-crime pattern of its own — occasional high-value residential burglaries reported in the press are a wealth-targeting issue, not a traveller safety one. Its southern/western edge does run along the Bois de Boulogne, which is the subject of an official Paris city council security report and repeated press coverage of nighttime street prostitution and related safety incidents; that risk is real but concentrated along specific Bois roads and after dark, and is more centred on the Porte-Dauphine side of the wood. Sources checked: Mairie de Paris / Conseil de Paris, security report on the Bois de Boulogne, presented ~November 2024; No incident specific to Auteuil's built-up residential streets found (search conducted August 2026).
